item.title: 一般现在时
item.description: 2. 一般现在时 (N1L47-60) 1. 习惯动作 / 客观事实 习惯动作: I always get up early. (我总是早起 ) He goes to that theater every weekend. They don’t go to that theater every weekend. Does he go to that theater every weekend? 客观事实: Sun raises on the left. (太阳从东边升起，)

item.title: 感叹句
item.description: 3. 感叹句 what + adj. + n. + [主语+谓语] [主语+谓语]可以省略 It it a terrible day. What a terrible day (it is). What a tall man he is. This is a beautiful picture. What a beautiful picture. This is a wonderful garden. What a wonderful garden. What a wonderful world. Hakuna-matata means “no worries”. What a wonderful phrase.

item.title: 现在进行时表将来
item.description: 现在进行时表示将来 红皮书 初25 & 中19 出现位置 [[N1L25]] [[N2L019]] 表示 近期计划， 已经安排的事情。 I’m meeting my friends tonight. We are having a party next weekend.

item.title: 现在进行时表示当前阶段状态
item.description: 表示最近一段时间的状态, 但是不一定是现在正在发生。 He’s driving very fast these days. I’m working on a new project there days.

item.title: 英语造句格式
item.description: 如何造句 主+谓+宾+how+where+when 找到句子主干。 主谓宾 / 主系表 a woman is shouting. 扩展句子： 形容词+n. / 副词+v. An ugly woman is shouting angrily. A pretty woman is shouting happily. 扩展地点, 扩展时间。 An ugly woman is shouting in the car at night. A pretty woman is shouting happily on the beach in the morning. Practice: I enjoyed the film yesterday I listened to the news carefully.
